title.zh: 单一中心之界所计为何

statement.en: On a net going forward in time the root's condition is exactly: from each center everything later is reached, and nothing else lies at or before the center's step; the second part admits one center, and over what comes after two can meet it.
statement.zh: 于时间中向前之网上，根上之条件恰为：自每个中心较后之一切可及，且无他物在中心之步或之前；第二部分只容一个中心，而于其后者，二中心可满足之。

laws.en: An element related to nothing returns, with no premise; on a relation without cycles the returning elements are exactly those, and held de se at them the condition holds exactly where, if there is a sink, there is only one element. On the net read off a continuation an occurrence returns exactly where nothing continues it.
laws.zh: 不与任何物相关之元素回返，无须前提；于无环之关系上回返者恰为此等，于其处从己持有，条件恰在“若有汇则只有一个元素”处成立。于从延续读出之网上，出现回返恰在无物延续之处。

laws.en: Where every condition comes at an earlier step than what it conditions, the root's condition holds exactly where, from each center, everything at a later step is reached on a line under the class, and nothing other than the center lies at or before its step. The second part alone admits one center, with no net, and nothing reached can meet it.
laws.zh: 凡每一缘之步早于其所缘者，根上之条件恰在：自每个中心，较后之步之一切于类下之线上可及，且除中心外无物在其步或之前。第二部分单独即只容一个中心，无须网，所及无一能满足之。
declarations: Becoming.«续无外当且仅当后与独»

laws.en: Over what comes after, two distinct centers meet the condition: two sources of one later occurrence, on a net without cycles where the root's condition fails; and on a flow exchanging at every step, every occurrence.
laws.zh: 于其后者，二不同中心满足条件：同一较后出现之二源，于无环之网上而根上之条件不成立；于每步交换之流上，每个出现皆然。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Any carrier, net and class; a step given to each occurrence, with every condition at an earlier step than what it conditions, where the split is stated.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。任意载体、网与类；陈述此分解处，每个出现有其步，每一缘之步早于其所缘者。

hypotheses.en: The condition read over what comes after the center's step: a reading, which the condition's source states as continuation into the future.
hypotheses.zh: 条件读于中心之步其后者：一种读法；条件之源表述为向未来之延续。

does_not_show.en: That the root's condition admits one center in time: what it admits one center for is the part about what lies at or before each center.
does_not_show.zh: 根上之条件于时间中只容一个中心：其只容一个中心，是因关于各中心之时或之前者那一部分。

does_not_show.en: That a significance holding over what comes after is the continuation condition: wherever something lies at or before, it is a rival in the sense of the region law.
does_not_show.zh: 于其后者成立之意义即延续条件：凡有物在其时或之前处，依区域之律它是对手。

does_not_show.en: Anything of a relation with cycles: there the returning elements need not be sinks.
does_not_show.zh: 有环之关系：其处回返者不必为汇。

detail.en: TwoSources: a and b at the first step each condition z at the next; from each, z is reached, the net has no cycle, and the root's condition fails (TwoSources.apart).
detail.zh: TwoSources：首步之 a 与 b 各缘次步之 z；自各者 z 可及，网无环，而根上之条件不成立（TwoSources.apart）。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, axiom reports empty; a leaf. Written by an AI; an AI reader of another model read the statements against the Lean, this record and the home section, cold, for overclaim (READER in the study folder); no human audit. Near-definitional compositions of the closure laws, with the witnesses checked on their models; none is new as mathematics.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核心，公理报告为空；叶模块。AI 所写；另一模型的一位 AI 读者对照 Lean、此记录与归属节冷读诸陈述，查是否言过其实（见研究目录 READER）；无人类审计。皆为闭包律之近于定义的组合，见证在其模型上检验；无一是新数学。

correspondence.en: On a graded acyclic digraph, a vertex from which every vertex is reachable is the unique minimum; restricted to later layers, any number of vertices can reach everything after them.
correspondence.zh: 于分层无环有向图上，可达一切顶点之顶点即唯一最小者；限于较后之层，任意多顶点皆可达其后之一切。

next_delta.en: The same split for a class coarser than the one, where a line continues past a member's end: which part of the condition a line under the class meets in time.
next_delta.zh: 对粗于“一”之类作同样分解，其线越过成员之终而续：类下之线于时间中满足条件之哪一部分。

aliases: 单一中心之界所计为何
Becoming.«续无外当且仅当后与独»

detail.en: «续无外», «续无外则同一中心» and «相续含于及».
detail.zh: 「续无外」、「续无外则同一中心」与「相续含于及」。

detail.en: A rule bounded in time is a rival of the condition; the condition over what comes after is such a restriction.
detail.zh: 限于时间之规则是条件之对手；于其后者之条件即此种限制。

detail.en: The same split on a flow read in time, where the condition over what comes after is coupling at every next step.
detail.zh: 于以时间读之流上作同样分解，于其后者之条件即每下一步之耦合。

declarations: Becoming.«续无外当且仅当后与独»
